summary: Expanded the US-listed universe one layer beneath obvious HBM producers and GPU leaders. The direct US-listed substrate-maker universe appears thin, so the cleaner US-listed mappings are advanced-packaging OSAT capacity, surface-treatment and plating chemistry/equipment, inspection/metrology, and wafer/package test yield-enablement.
